market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $115 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: Resolution uses CME settlement (not intraday high) for active-month CL. WTI front-month near 06 with Hormuz disruption; EIA forecasts Q2 2026 Brent peak ~15 (WTI typically -5 below Brent). To settle at 15 by end-June requires ~9% sustained rise. Plausible if Hormuz remains shut, but ~50/50 given OPEC+ supply hike and possible diplomacy.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Duration of Hormuz disruption; OPEC+ supply response.
